candidate_action.source: outer-training source truth minus exact E011 OOF prediction

control_gate.pass_condition_for_main: the best configuration from every destructive control must fail at least one of the five main coverage gates
control_gate.procedure: each shuffled/reversed control repeats the full 81-point oracle screen with unchanged thresholds and outer folds

oracle_evaluation.aggregation: mean of five map-specific oracle actions per well
oracle_evaluation.promotion: all preregistered coverage gates must pass; otherwise close retrieval
oracle_evaluation.selection: best hidden-label SSE among top-k outer-training neighbors or zero action inside each context

prohibited_after_first_metric: changing distance formula or component scaling
adding neighbors, weights, beta values, or branches
implementing a legal selector inside T032

registration.dtw: exact compiled Sakoe-Chiba DTW; radius 8 percent; radii 6 and 8 bins
registration.fold_scaling: outer-library median positive DTW distance and geometry median/IQR only
registration.horizontal_gr: 96-bin whole-horizontal robust-z GR plus finite-mask channel
registration.typewell_gr: 96-bin typewell robust-z GR plus finite-mask channel

streaming_contract.controls: run each destructive control sequentially; materialize at most one 81x5x773 int32 source-index cube per control
streaming_contract.main_grid: score and discard each of 81 configurations sequentially; reconstruct predictions only for the winning configuration
streaming_contract.memory_target: remain below preregistered 4 GB RSS cap
streaming_contract.prediction_materialization: never retain all-well path predictions for more than one configuration
